svg.text: STAGE 444 · TOPIC 84 · P881 / P882 · 900 PROBES 🎉 · 710 LIVE POC 🎉
WebRTC RFC 3711 / RFC 4588 SRTP ROC Rollover Auth-Before-Commit & RTX OSN Isolation Guard
企业 WebRTC RFC 3711/4588 SRTP 32-bit ROC 先验签后翻转、迟到入会同步与 RTX OSN 独立 SSRC 防污染门禁（🎉 891 护栏、900 探针与 710 现场探针里程碑）
1. SRTP ROC Auth-Before-Commit & Late-Join Gate (P881)
• 痛点：未验签前修改 ROC 被单包致盲永久静音，或 22 分钟后新入会假设 ROC=0
• 原子翻转：只读临时 v 先过 AEAD 验签再提交 ROC，防重放窗口锁在 [128, 1024]
❌ Desync: Spoofed SEQ=0 mutates ROC | Late-joiner assumes ROC=0 at min 25
✅ P881 Gate: Verify AEAD Tag Before ROC Commit + Sync Late-Joiner + [128,1024]
Action: verify_aead_tag_before_committing_roc_and_sync_late_joiner_roc
确定性收敛指标（P881）：
✔ clampedRocDesyncPermanentAuthFailureStreams = 0（0 翻转失步永久静音流）
✔ clampedSrtpReplayWindowPackets ∈ [128, 1024]（高容量滑动防重放窗口）
2. RFC 4588 RTX Separate-SSRC & OSN Gate (P882)
• 痛点：跨 65535->0 边界重传旧包若混用主流 SSRC 会导致 ROC 反复横跳错乱
• 独立解包：强制独立 RTX SSRC 验签后剥离 2B OSN，重传历史锁在 [200, 1000]ms
❌ Pollution: Shared-SSRC retransmit across 65535->0 corrupts 5 primary ROCs
✅ P882 Gate: Isolate RTX SSRC Replay State + Unwrap 2B OSN + [200, 1000]ms
Action: isolate_rtx_ssrc_replay_state_and_unwrap_osn_before_primary_inject
确定性收敛指标（P882）：
✔ clampedRtxInducedPrimaryRocCorruptions = 0（0 重传诱导的主流 ROC 污染）
✔ clampedMaxRtxRetransmissionHistoryMs ∈ [200, 1000] ms（重传历史缓存窗口）
3. Quantitative Evaluation Matrix & Production Verification Checklist (Stage 444 · Topic 84 · 900 Probes 🎉 · 710 Live POC 🎉)
• Guardrail P881: evaluateWebrtcSrtpRfc3711RocRolloverAuthenticateBeforeCommitAndLateJoinerSyncGate => 0 ROC desyncs | [128, 1024] win
• Guardrail P882: evaluateWebrtcRtpRfc4588RtxOsnSeparateSsrcReplayWindowAndAptBindingGate => 0 RTX corrupt | [200, 1000]ms
• Checklist: [x] Auth-Before-Commit Candidate v [x] Late-Joiner ROC Sync [x] Separate RTX SSRC + 2B OSN [x] [200,1000]ms RTX Buffer
